about: Pairing crypto vectors (docs/security.md section 5). Hex unless noted. Both platforms must reproduce every value.

definitions.code: m = HMAC-SHA256(key=nPc || nPhone, ASCII('PB-SAS-1') || fpPc || fpPhone); ((big-endian uint32 of m[0..4]) & 0x7FFFFFFF) mod 1000000, zero-padded to 6 digits
definitions.uri: fp and s are base64url without padding; n is percent-encoded (RFC 3986, space = %20)
